title: MFSSIA: Ontology of blockchain-based multi-factor challenge set self-sovereign identity authentication
scope: Challenge-response identity authentication and marketplace semantics in M2X
cm4di_overlap: Authentication; trust; non-human actors; identity verification; UFO grounding
cm4di_delta: CM4DI targets cross-paradigm reference semantics across enterprise, credentials, government, workload/device/agent, authorization and standards/framework mappings with broader formal/evaluation architecture

title: An Ontology-Based Architecture for Federated Identity Management
scope: Federated identity architecture with circle-of-trust, IdP/SP and intermediate concepts
cm4di_overlap: Federation; IdentityProvider; ServiceProvider; CircleOfTrust; OWL formalization
cm4di_delta: CM4DI is broader, foundationally grounded, DDD/modular, current-standard aligned and evaluated across multiple paradigms; direct historical OWL comparison is required

title: An Ontology-Based Identity and Access Management Metamodel for Secure Adaptive Enterprise Architecture
scope: Enterprise IAM and adaptive enterprise architecture
cm4di_overlap: Identity management; access management; security architecture; metamodel
cm4di_delta: CM4DI contributes a cross-paradigm identity reference ontology and formal standards/framework/neighbor mappings rather than an enterprise-architecture-specific IAM metamodel

title: SemID: Combining Semantics with Identity Management
scope: Corporate identity management with roles, policies, rules, resources and privacy/access control
cm4di_overlap: Identity management; role/policy/resource access; semantic-web ontology
cm4di_delta: Historical formal IAM ontology focused on corporate access-control semantics; CM4DI separates identity, authorization, federation, credential/government/non-human domains and adds foundational grounding plus current standards/evaluation

title: Distributed Identity Management for Semantic Entities (semDIM)
venue: Semantic Web related proceedings / Springer CCIS
formalism: modular DUL-based OWL ontology patterns; semantic-web architecture
scope: Distributed definition and management of persons, groups and roles across namespaces; formal reasoning and implementation
cm4di_overlap: Distributed identifiers; persons/groups/roles; cross-namespace identity; reasoning; modular semantic architecture
cm4di_delta: Particularly important contrast: semDIM centrally uses owl:sameAs for distributed identity, whereas CM4DI treats account linking/co-reference conservatively and separates IdentitySubject, DigitalIdentity and Account; CM4DI also has broader standards/government/workload/credential/trust scope

title: Decentralized Semantic Identity
formalism: Semantic Web identity architecture using WebID/FOAF/JWT/blockchain
scope: Personal semantic identity and decentralized authentication
cm4di_overlap: semantic identity representation; claims; authentication; decentralized user control
cm4di_delta: Architecture/semantic identity comparator rather than a well-founded cross-paradigm reference ontology; CM4DI remains technology-neutral and separates identity representation from protocol/blockchain mechanisms
